profile_text.body:
Vercel is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company's website presents v0, described as a collaborative AI assistant for designing, iterating, and scaling full-stack web applications.

v0 by Vercel is tracked in the coding and developer tools category, with a focus on UI generation. The product is positioned as an end-to-end tool for building full-stack web apps with AI assistance.
